clues.title: Parents pay repeat Fiverr gigs for customized printable kids worksheets
clues.quote: Every printable worksheet, kids worksheet, and activity sheet is delivered in PDF, gig selling with hundreds of reviews.
clues.persona_context: Parents buying custom printable study sheets for elementary kids
clues.input_data: Child age, weak math/reading topic, and interest theme

clues.title: Single mom overwhelmed by screen-time battles during evening housework
clues.quote: When work is busy or I'm overwhelmed with housework, I usually end up caving and letting him play games until I'm done. He gets extremely agitated when it's time to turn it off.
clues.persona_context: Single working mother of a 7-year-old boy
clues.input_data: Household items available + 30-minute chore window + child mood
clues.output_data: Audio-guided offline mission + zero-meltdown screen transition script

clues.title: Too many school apps (ClassDojo, Seesaw, PowerSchool) overwhelming parents
clues.quote: The number of different apps they use for grades and communication is ridiculous. First off, we teachers don't like that we have to have four apps to get in touch with parents.
clues.persona_context: Parents with multiple kids across different teachers and school apps
clues.input_data: Notifications and emails from 4-6 school apps
clues.output_data: Single weekly family action digest and .ics calendar feed

clues.title: Generic baby growth percentile chart tracker
clues.quote: I have a free version of Baby Growth Chart Percentile with an optional tip jar.
clues.persona_context: Casual new parent logging height and weight
